summary: Combat Audio Layers v1: layered combat audio over B1 k4-audio-foundation limiter and B2-X1 combat event spine. direct_hit -> light layer (PUNCH_CLEAN_LIGHT_02, 100ms window), crit -> heavy layer (ice_crack, 150ms window), kill -> kill layer (blood_explosion, 300ms window + cluster aggregation >=3 -> single sound), dot_tick -> suppressed (no per-tick impact spam). All audio still funnels through k4 play_sound_effect (voice budget 16 / per-stream 60ms / pitch+volume variation / tree_exited accounting preserved). Stats.gd drains _spine_last_events incrementally (consumed-seq) at the end of apply_damage, capturing kill records before the victim is freed by the deferred died signal. No damage/event semantics change; no new binary assets. B3-S5 FIX 2026-08-20: kill layer suppressed when killer dead (no sound after player death); player drain suppressed after death.
